title: Multiorder Fractional Operators: The Conformable Multiorder Derivative and Its Associated Multiorder Integral
summary: This paper introduces a novel class of non-linear multiorder fractional differential operators. First, we provide intuitive and formal justifications for the existence of multiorder differential operators through differential analysis and Omega-derivative formulations. We then define the conformable multiorder derivative as a functional quotient of fractional derivatives and establish its analytical properties rigorously.
